Tls13Suite = enum
  tlsAes128GcmSha256,       ## `TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` (HKDF-SHA-256).
  tlsAes256GcmSha384,       ## `TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384` (HKDF-SHA-384).
  tlsChacha20Poly1305Sha256  ## `TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256` (HKDF-SHA-256).
